lines.text: OpenAI cuts raise target to ~$20B from $30B after ~$11B raised; FT/WSJ (~$1.25T)
Google, OpenAI, Microsoft back one robots.txt signal to opt sites out of AI training
OpenAI signs UAE deals: ADNOC, machine-readable gov, Mubadala/Inception42

feed.headline: FT/WSJ: OpenAI cuts raise target to ~$20B from $30B after ~$11B in
feed.why: Reported only; OpenAI has not confirmed. Valuation cited around $1.25T, down from about $1.4T.

feed.headline: Google, OpenAI, Microsoft back one robots.txt AI-training opt-out signal
feed.why: usage_ai-training draft. Google says support in 2027; OpenAI “in coming months.” Bing posted the same day.

feed.headline: OpenAI signs four Abu Dhabi deals spanning energy, government, and investment
feed.why: ADNOC deploys GPT models on UAE in-country inference; machine-readable government pilot; Mubadala and a five-year Inception42 pact.

feed.headline: OpenAI: ChatGPT and Codex will share one usage allowance in December
feed.why: Plus, Pro, and Business metered in tokens across both. Instant chat stays free of the allowance. No exact start day or sizes yet.

feed.headline: DeepSeek open-sources dsh-superagent coding-agent prototype (MIT)
feed.why: Harness-team research code for one GitHub repo. README says not an official product and not identical to the internal design article.

feed.headline: Apple Intelligence coming to China: Qwen-powered beta Wed 4 Nov
feed.why: Developer beta 4 Nov; public rollout in December with iOS 27.3. Powers Siri, Writing Tools, and Visual Intelligence in China.

feed.headline: xAI: Grok API text watermarking on by default from Sat 7 Nov
feed.why: Covers grok-4.7/4.6/4.5/4.3/4.20 plus tool-call arguments. Team admins can opt out per model.

feed.headline: Pika H3 Flex reaches the Pika creation product
feed.why: Open weights and API launched 29 Oct on MiniMax H3. Consumer app date was Nov 2 per Pika’s own post.

feed.headline: Apple FY26 Q4 after the close; call 5:00 PM ET
feed.why: First Ternus-as-CEO print. Market will listen for AI / Siri and the China Apple Intelligence timing.

feed.headline: Kimi K3.1 Pro full weights still promised by Nov 4
feed.why: API and apps already live. As of this morning Moonshot’s HF org still shows Kimi-K3, not K3.1 Pro.
